info.title: GDMacros Public API
info.description: Public read-only catalog API. Production firewall: 60 requests per IP per 60-second fixed window across /api/v1 and its children, excluding OPTIONS. CDN caches successful responses for 300 seconds with 60 seconds stale revalidation. No ETag/304 contract. Lists use catalog alphabetical level order and recording order within each level. No permanent recording IDs or write/account API. Catalog changes require deployment; pagination is not snapshot-isolated across deployments. Availability is subject to hosting limits.

get.summary: List matching levels with all their recordings
get.description: Public, read-only. No API key. Unknown or repeated query parameters are rejected. GET and HEAD share status/headers; HEAD has no body. OPTIONS returns 204 for CORS preflight.

parameters.name: search
parameters.description: Case-insensitive literal substring after trimming. Levels search name, creator, ID and recording author/recorder/host; recordings search level name/creator/ID and that recording author/recorder. Not a regular expression.

parameters.name: recorder
parameters.description: Exact recorder name. URL-encode spaces, for example Mega%20Hack.

parameters.name: fps
parameters.description: Exact recording FPS match. Positive finite decimal or scientific notation; no range matching or 240 FPS cap.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: One-based page. Use plain integer digits without a leading zero.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Results per page. Use plain integer digits without a leading zero.

levelId.description: Geometry Dash level ID, represented as a string.

slug.description: Current website slug; it may change when a level is renamed.

addedAt.description: Date the level was added, or null when unknown.

author.description: Catalog recording credit, not a verified account identity.

recorder.description: Exact recorder name, including case and spaces.

fps.description: Positive finite recording FPS, including decimal rates; use this rate for playback.

testedAt.description: Recorded last-tested date, or null. Historical values may be upload-date baselines, not new playback verification.

downloadUrl.description: Public recording file URL. Download directly from this host, not through the API.
